family.description: The UpxZ family of proteins acts to inhibit transcription of heterologous capsular polysaccharide loci in Bacteroides species by interfering with the action of the UpxY family of transcription anti-terminators. As antagonists of polysaccharide locus-specific UpxY transcription anti-terminators, the UpxZ proteins exert a hierarchical level of regulation, insuring that only one of the multiple phase-variable capsular polysaccharide loci per cell characteristic of this genus is transcribed at a time.
family.name: UpxZ family of transcription anti-terminator antagonists
